title: Art frame
description: A parametric hardwood art frame with a choice of corner joints and a rear artwork rabbet. Compare assembled and exploded joints, dimensioned drawings, and stock requirements.
notes: Extended from the supplied Onshape FeatureScript, with the original half-lap as the default. Dimensions are in inches; displayed bounds and STL exports are in millimetres. Choose half-lap, plain miter, mitered half-lap, corner bridle or mitered bridle. The mitered lap and bridle have 45-degree front faces and square back shoulders. Zero lap depth uses half the stock thickness; zero tongue thickness uses one third. The rear rabbet starts at Z=0. Clearance enlarges the rear pocket without changing the visible opening. Each member has its own color; select a single part for a separate STL. Drawings and the four-sheet PDF describe the selected joint. Matching blanks share cut-list rows with adjustable rough-stock allowances.
